meta.commit_title: [Feature][MRV2] Default Model Runner V2 for all configurations (#16848)

project_overview.what: vllm-ascend is the hardware plugin that lets vLLM run on Huawei Ascend NPUs (910B/A2, 910C/A3, 310P, Ascend 950/A5). It is not a fork of vLLM: it plugs into vLLM's pluggable hardware interface, registers a platform via an entry point, and supplies NPU implementations of the attention, worker, model-runner, communicator, graph, quantization, sampling and scheduling abstractions.
problems_solved: Ports vLLM's CUDA-centric runtime to Ascend NPU: replaces CUDA graphs with ACL/NPUGraph, CUDA streams with torch.npu streams, NCCL with HCCL.
Bridges kernel/format gaps: Ascend needs NZ (fractal) weight/KV cache layouts, CANN custom operators, and different paged-attention / fused-infer-attention APIs.
Fills upstream gaps with monkey patches for features vLLM has not yet made pluggable.
Adapts specific model families (DeepSeek V4/V4.1, GLM-5.3-Flash, MiniMax-M3/M2, Kimi K3, Qwen3.5, Gemma4) and speculative decoding (MTP/Eagle/DSpark/DFlash) that are not upstream.
Provides ops, scheduling extensions (recompute, dyntra-lb, short-request-first, profiling chunk), EPLB and KV-transfer for NPU deployments.

core_modules.responsibility: Plugin entry points. register() returns 'vllm_ascend.platform.NPUPlatform'; register_connector()/register_model_loader()/register_service_profiling()/register_model() register KV/weight connectors, custom model loaders, profiling hooks and NPU model classes. Also patches triton-experimental stubs and triton.language.core._aggregate for compatibility.
core_modules.implementation_principle: vLLM discovers general plugins through Python entry points; each register_* call runs _ensure_global_patch() so process-wide (platform) patches are applied in engine-core subprocesses before engine-core init. _GLOBAL_PATCH_APPLIED guards idempotency.

core_modules.responsibility: NPUPlatform: the platform abstraction vLLM calls for all device/hardware decisions. Overrides device/quantization capability introspection, attention backend selection (get_attn_backend_cls), pass manager, compile backend, communicator class, static graph wrapper, config validation/repair (check_and_update_config) and forward-context extras (set_additional_forward_context).
core_modules.implementation_principle: check_and_update_config runs a numbered pipeline: sync V2 extra kwargs, logging, parallel validation, quantization auto-detect, _fix_incompatible_config (forces GPU-only flags off), AscendConfig init/validation, compilation mode updates, compile backend + worker/scheduler setup, SFA/DCP/KV/SP consistency, allocator env. apply_config_platform_defaults caps CUDAGraph capture size (MC2 workaround).

core_modules.responsibility: AscendConfig: pydantic @config dataclass holding all Ascend-specific tuning (accessed via --additional-config JSON). Contains nested configs: KVPPConfig, AscendCompilationConfig, AscendFusionConfig, StairConfig, AscendWarmupConfig, EplbConfig, RejectionSamplerConfig, RlConfig, DynamicSpecConfig, FinegrainedTPConfig, XliteGraphConfig, ProfilingChunkConfig, BatchJobSchedConfig, ShortRequestFirstConfig, DyntraLBConfig, SchedulerConfig, SparseKVOffloadConfig.
core_modules.implementation_principle: extra='forbid' rejects typos; lax bool/int coercion fixes bool('false'); derive_and_validate(vllm_config) computes derived fields, applies hardware-profile downgrades and mutex checks. init_ascend_config builds/caches the singleton; get_ascend_config reads it.

core_modules.responsibility: Central env_variables dict for VLLM_ASCEND_* and build-time variables (MAX_JOBS, SOC_VERSION, COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS, HCCL_SO_PATH, DYNAMIC_EPLB, VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_BATCH_MEMCPY, VLLM_ASCEND_KVPOOL_RANGE_DEBUG, VLLM_ASCEND_ROPE_UB_SIZE_KB).
core_modules.implementation_principle: Lazy module-level __getattr__ evaluates each lambda on access, following upstream vllm/envs.py conventions.

core_modules.responsibility: Ascend attention backends, metadata, builders and impls for GQA, MLA, SFA (sparse flash attention / DeepSeek indexer), DSA (compressed sparse attention / DeepSeek-V4), FA3 (RL consistency), plus context-parallel variants (PCP/DCP). KV-cache shape and NZ-format handling.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Each backend is a vLLM AttentionBackend subclass selected by NPUPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls from (use_mla, use_sparse, use_compress). Backends return impl/builder/metadata classes. Ascend replaces vLLM's generic kernel calls with CANN ops (npu_fused_infer_attention_score, npu_paged_attention, npu_kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache, sparse_flash_attention). KV cache physical layout uses get_kv_cache_shape (5D K/V tuple for GQA, 4D for MLA/SFA/DSA; 310P folds head dim into 16-aligned inner dim). NZ is a runtime view: logical allocation + 5D/16/32-aligned views passed to CANN ops, controlled by AscendConfig.enable_kv_nz and VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.

core_modules.responsibility: NPUWorker (single worker class selecting v1/v2 runner at init), NPUModelRunner V1 (worker/model_runner_v1.py) and V2 (worker/v2/model_runner.py), NPUInputBatch/AscendInputBatch, block tables, model states, sample/ and spec_decode/ subpackages, KV block zeroer, PP utils, DCP utils, EPLB controller, PCP manager.
core_modules.implementation_principle: V2 is the default. NPUWorker.init_device picks vllm_ascend.worker.v2.model_runner.NPUModelRunner when vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner else the V1 NPUModelRunner. Heavy customization for V2 is patch-driven (patch_v2/) rather than pure inheritance because upstream keeps several V2 objects as module globals.

core_modules.responsibility: ACL graph capture/replay (ACLGraphWrapper), breakable graph wrapper, UpdatableGraph host-side params, AscendCompiler (torch.compile backend), GraphFusionPassManager and fusion passes (norm+quant, qk-norm+rope, muls+add, noop elimination, allgather-chunk noop).
core_modules.implementation_principle: ACLGraphWrapper mirrors vllm.compilation.cuda_graph.CUDAGraphWrapper's API but uses torch.npu.NPUGraph. capture/replay are inlined in __call__; attention metadata is updated host-side via UpdatableGraph graph_task_update_begin/end. AscendCompiler uses npugraph_ex (falls back to torchair), and the pass manager runs Inductor FX patterns over the graph.

core_modules.responsibility: NPUCommunicator (DeviceCommunicatorBase), Ascend parallel-state groups (MC2, MLP-TP, O-TP, LM-head TP, embed TP, prefill-TP, dynamic-EPLB, KVPP), pyhccl ctypes communicator, KV transfer connectors (mooncake, ascend_store, UCM, sparse offload, SFA PD RD2H), weight transfer (HCCL/IPC), EC transfer.
core_modules.implementation_principle: NPUCommunicator only sets the NPU device and a no-op all2all manager; actual collectives route through vLLM GroupCoordinator/HCCL process groups. init_ascend_model_parallel builds a 5-D rank grid [ExternalDP, DP, PP, PCP, TP] and creates fine-grained TP groups. PyHcclCommunicator wraps libhccl.so via ctypes for weight/RL transfer.

core_modules.responsibility: Expert Parallel Load Balancing: EplbUpdator (orchestrates update cycle, D2D weight transfer tasks), EplbWorker/EplbProcess (subprocess policy computation), VllmEplbAdaptor (per-layer expert weight views/maps), policies (Random, Default, Swift, FlashLB/STAIR), device transfer loader.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Levels: collect per-layer expert load (all_gather over dynamic EPLB group) → policy computes rebalanced placement → compose per-layer send/recv → D2D async weight transfer → update expert_map/log2phy. Runs in a dedicated daemon subprocess to overlap with inference.

core_modules.responsibility: Ascend quantization configs (compressed-tensors, fp8, deepseek_v4_fp8, modelopt mxfp8, modelslim) and schemes (W8A8/W8A8-dynamic/W8A8-mxfp8/W8A8-fp8-dynamic, W4A8/W4A8-mxfp, W4A4/laos/mxfp4/flatquant, W4A16/W8A16, KV-c8), method adapters (AscendLinearMethod, AscendFusedMoEMethod, AscendKVCacheMethod, AscendEmbeddingMethod), registry, quant parser and methodslim config.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Configs wrap upstream QuantizationConfig subclasses and register with @register_quantization_config(method). Schemes are looked up by (quant_type, layer_type) in _SCHEME_REGISTRY, decoupling quant algorithm from layer type. Method adapters bridge schemes to vLLM's LinearMethodBase/FusedMoEMethodBase.

core_modules.responsibility: AscendSampler, AscendTopKTopPSampler, AscendRejectionSampler, penalties. Replace Triton sampling ops with CANN/torch_npu implementations; add reduce-sample TP path.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Subclass vLLM Sampler/RejectionSampler and override apply_penalties/prepare_sampling/forward to dispatch to Ascend kernels (apply_top_k_top_p, rejection sampling). V2 sample kernels live under worker/v2/sample/ and are rebound onto upstream modules by patch_v2/patch_triton.py.

core_modules.responsibility: Scheduler extensions (recompute_scheduler, dyntra_lb_scheduler, short_request_first_scheduler, scheduler_profiling_chunk, batch_job_aware_scheduler), KV cache interface/spec registry and KV placement, profiling chunk predictor.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Each scheduler subclasses vllm.v1.core.sched.scheduler.Scheduler (or AsyncScheduler/RequestQueue) and overrides schedule/update_from_output/_preempt_request. KV specs subclass vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface specs and are registered into KVCacheSpecRegistry with concrete managers.

core_modules.responsibility: NPU-specific model implementations registered under architectures not (or differently) handled upstream: DeepSeek V4/V4.1, GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5next), MiniMax-M3, Kimi K3, Gemma4-MM, Qwen3 DSpark/DFlash2, MTP/Eagle3 draft models.
core_modules.implementation_principle: register_model() calls vllm.ModelRegistry.register_model(arch, 'module:Class') so vLLM's own loader resolves the Ascend class. Classes are plain nn.Module + upstream interface mixins (SupportsPP, SupportsLoRA, MixtureOfExperts, EagleModelMixin, IsHybrid).

core_modules.responsibility: V1 speculative-decoding proposers (Eagle, DraftModel, Medusa, Ngram, Suffix, ExtractHiddenStates, Gemma4, DSpark, DFlash, Step3p5, MultiKV).
core_modules.implementation_principle: Each subclass overrides upstream proposer methods for NPU layout/ops. V2 speculators live in worker/v2/spec_decode/.

core_modules.responsibility: Full 310P (Ascend310P3) compatibility stack: attention backend 310, FLA/GDN ops, quantization (modelslim 310), sample, spec decode, worker/runner 310, block table, input batch, model states, KV block zeroer.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Selected by HardwareProfile(device_type=310P): COMPATIBILITY attention/quant/adaptor families, FORCE_NZ weight layout, ALLGATHER MoE comm policy, default worker NPUWorker310. 310P lacks Triton; ops fall back to CANN/native.

core_modules.responsibility: Hardware identification and capability abstraction: AscendDeviceType, DeviceConfig, HardwareCapability enum, HardwareProfile and profile table, DeviceOperator adaptor dispatch (Base/A5/310P), hardware utils.
core_modules.implementation_principle: hardware.py is import-safe (stdlib only) and resolves device type at build time (soc_version) or runtime (torch_npu SOC ranges). hardware_profile.py maps each device type to a frozen HardwareProfile of capability flags; feature code asks profile.supports(Capability) instead of branching on device name.

core_modules.responsibility: CaMemAllocator (CANN-mem based pluggable PyTorch allocator for NPU sleep mode) and SleepWakeupManager (ACL graph/HCCL teardown + recapture).
core_modules.implementation_principle: caMem wraps torch.npu.memory.NPUPluggableAllocator with custom my_malloc/my_free from vllm_ascend_C; sleep() backs up D2H and unmaps tagged allocations, wake_up() remaps and restores H2D. SleepWakeupManager additionally releases/rebuilds ACL graph params and HCCL groups.

core_modules.responsibility: NetLoader (elastic network weight streaming) and RFork loader (weight transfer from a seed process), both custom BaseModelLoader implementations registered via register_model_loader entry point.
core_modules.implementation_principle: They subclass vllm.model_executor.model_loader.base_loader.BaseModelLoader and register under 'netloader'/'rfork'; fall back to DefaultModelLoader if streaming is unavailable.

core_modules.responsibility: PunicaWrapperNPU and NPU LoRA ops (fused MoE lora, punica).
core_modules.implementation_principle: Subclasses vllm.lora.punica_wrapper.punica_base.PunicaWrapperBase and overrides shrink/expand/add_lora_linear/fused_moe/logits to use Ascend custom ops when HardwareCapability.LORA_CUSTOM_OPS is available.

core_modules.responsibility: Monkey patches split into platform/ (applied globally before workers start) and worker/ (applied in each worker __init__). Contains ~37 platform patches and ~21 worker patches documented in patch/__init__.py.
core_modules.implementation_principle: adapt_patch(is_global_patch) imports platform/* or worker/* package __init__, whose module-level imports perform the monkey patches. Platform patches are idempotent and applied in pre_register_and_update; worker patches are re-applied per worker process. A single engine-core wrapper (patch_engine_core.py) owns run_engine_core to avoid wrapper chains.

core_modules.responsibility: Custom operators and kernels: activation, layernorm, rope, linear/mla, GDN/KDA, DSA, fused MoE (dataclass/router/token dispatcher/prepare-finalize), Triton kernels (fla, kda, linearnorm, mamba, compressor, v2 sample/spec), custom op registration.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Fused MoE is decomposed into dataclasses (prepare/finalize, router, token dispatcher, moe_mlp) with a MoECommType strategy (ALLGATHER/MC2/ALLTOALL/FUSED_MC2) selected by token count and topology. Triton kernels mirror upstream but target triton-ascend.

core_modules.responsibility: OpenTelemetry-style observability hooks and TorchNPUProfiler wrapper.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Thin wrappers registered via plugin entry points; profiler_interface wraps torch_npu profiler for vLLM's profile API.

core_modules.responsibility: XLite experimental execution path with its own worker/model runner.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Alternative worker selected via AscendConfig.xlite_graph_config; separate runner bypasses the standard NPUWorker path.

core_modules.responsibility: C++/CANN custom operator sources and the compiled vllm_ascend_C extension plus custom_transformer operator package.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Built by CMake; loaded lazily via bootstrap_custom_op_env() to avoid applying ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES during import.

implementation_principles.npu_platform_registration: vLLM's pluggable hardware system loads the 'vllm_ascend' entry point; vllm_ascend/__init__.py::register() returns 'vllm_ascend.platform.NPUPlatform'. During engine startup vLLM imports the platform, calls pre_register_and_update (global patches + model config convertor + quantization registration), then check_and_update_config on every VllmConfig. Platform class is instantiated as current_platform and all abstract hooks (backend, worker, communicator, graph, pass manager, allocator) resolve to Ascend classes.
implementation_principles.npu_model_runner_diff: MRV2 NPUModelRunner overrides 12 upstream methods (execute_model, prepare_inputs, sample_tokens, sample, initialize_kv_cache, profile_run, gather_batch_req_state, prepare_dummy_attn, _dummy_run, postprocess_sampled, pcp_manager_cls, __init__) and adds 8 Ascend helpers (FIA query-start padding, seq-lens CPU update, lmhead TP logits cap, replicated draft-target state restore). MRV1 NPUModelRunner overrides 46 methods and adds 49. V2 customization relies on patch_v2/ rebinding module globals (InputBatch, BlockTables, init_model_state, speculator/cudagraph classes, triton sample kernels) instead of inheritance because upstream keeps them as module attributes.
implementation_principles.acl_graph_vs_cuda_graph: ACLGraphWrapper mirrors upstream CUDAGraphWrapper semantics but uses torch.npu.NPUGraph / torch.npu.graph instead of CUDA. Capture and replay are inlined in __call__, grouped per BatchDescriptor. Host-side attention params are refreshed through UpdatableGraph (subclass of torch.npu.NPUGraph) using graph_task_update_begin/end and ExternalEvent.record. Differences: NZ-aware attention metadata updates, optional npugraph_ex/super_kernel static kernel path, Ascend-specific stream-resource and old-HDK capture error rewriting, offloader stream synchronization, and weak-ref workspace tracking via torch_npu._C._weak_ref_tensor.
implementation_principles.ascend_attention_nz: get_kv_cache_shape returns logical shapes (5D K/V for GQA, 4D for MLA/SFA/DSA; 310P folds head-size into 16-aligned inner dim). NZ (fractal) is applied as a runtime view: MLA views k_nope/k_pe with last dim 16 and selects PA_NZ cache mode; GQA/C8 views with last dim 32 and uses npu_scatter_pa_kv_cache. enable_kv_nz is restricted to MLA PD decode; VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT selects LBHNC/HND vs block-major.
implementation_principles.patch_mechanism: adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) is called in NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update (process-wide, before workers) and via _ensure_global_patch in plugin entry points; adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False) is called in each NPUWorker.__init__. platform/__init__.py conditionally imports patches by hardware capability (e.g. mamba_config vs mamba_config_310, multiproc_executor only when DYNAMIC_EPLB). patch_engine_core.py installs a single run_engine_core wrapper to avoid order-dependent wrapper chains across balance/duyntra/profiling patches.
implementation_principles.eplb_workflow: DYNAMIC_EPLB or --enable-eplb starts EplbProcess (daemon subprocess). EplbUpdator.forward_end gathers local MoE loads (all_gather over dynamic EPLB group), wakes the worker which runs the configured policy (Random/Default/Swift/FlashLB/STAIR), composes per-layer send/recv, and performs asynchronous D2D expert weight transfer; then expert map/log2phy and weight views are updated. Upstream EPLB is Model Runner V2 only on Ascend and forces torch_gloo async communicator.
implementation_principles.camem_allocator: Ascend does not use the CUDA cumem allocator. CaMemAllocator wraps torch.npu.memory.NPUPluggableAllocator (my_malloc/my_free from vllm_ascend_C) inside torch.npu.memory.MemPool, tagged 'default'/'sleep_persistent'. sleep() copies tagged allocations D2H and unmaps device memory; wake_up() remaps and restores. SleepWakeupManager additionally tears down/rebuilds ACL graph params and HCCL groups.
implementation_principles.hardware_differences: A2 (910B), A3 (910C), 310P and A5 (Ascend 950) differ by HardwareProfile: attention/quant/adaptor family (STANDARD vs COMPATIBILITY vs FP8_OPTIMIZED), weight layout (CONFIGURABLE vs FORCE_NZ), MoE comm policy (FUSED_OR_CAPACITY / CAPACITY_AND_WORLD_SIZE / ALLGATHER), addressing mode (DIRECT vs DUAL_CHIP_CARD) and a large set of per-capability flags. 310P selects NPUWorker310, Ascend310PDeviceAdaptor, AscendModelSlimConfig310, AscendAttentionBackend310 and an entirely separate _310p stack. A5 enables FP8 attention, mega-MoE MXFP and dynamic MX quant fusion.

device: none / stdlib-only in hardware.py; device_op depends on torch_npu and custom ops

device_types.A2: Ascend 910B, STANDARD attention/adaptor/quant, TOPO_AFFINITY CPU binding, DIRECT addressing, CONFIGURABLE weight layout, CAPACITY_AND_EXPERT_DENSITY MoE policy
device_types.A3: Ascend 910C, STANDARD, GLOBAL_SLICE CPU binding, DUAL_CHIP_CARD addressing, FUSED_OR_CAPACITY MoE policy
device_types.310P: Ascend310P3, COMPATIBILITY attention/adaptor/quant, FORCE_NZ weight layout, ALLGATHER MoE policy, default worker NPUWorker310
device_types.A5: Ascend 950, STANDARD attention/quant, FP8_OPTIMIZED adaptor, TOPO_AFFINITY, CONFIGURABLE, CAPACITY_AND_WORLD_SIZE MoE policy

platform_specific_implementations: triton vs CANN/native op fallbacks (310P has no Triton)

inheritable_interfaces.impact: Abstract-method or signature changes here break vllm-ascend universally at startup.
Changing get_name/get_impl_cls/get_builder_cls contract or the backend registry changes breaks attention selection.
forward/forward_mha/forward_mqa signature or expected kv_cache container changes break the model forward path.
CommonAttentionMetadata/build signature changes break metadata construction and graph capture.
V2 is the default runner; any of these changes breaks default operation.
V1 fallback path for LoRA/pooling/310P/spec features; changes break those modes.
Process bootstrap/device init changes break all deployments.

Slot-mapping dtype/contract changes break block table construction (Ascend needs int32).
init_model_state is patch-rebound; prepare_attn signature changes break attention metadata and Mamba state handling.
Collective API changes break TP/DP/EP and MoE communication.
CompilerInterface changes break torch.compile graph mode.
CUDAGraphMode/CUDAGraphOptions/BatchDescriptor and wrapper nesting contract changes break graph capture/replay.
Pass base/context changes break graph fusion.
Sampling API/metadata changes break token sampling and speculative verification.
Quant config contract changes break all Ascend quantization.
Method base signature changes break weight loading and forward for quantized layers.
Spec API changes break KV memory planning; registration through KVCacheSpecRegistry must stay compatible.
These subclasses copy upstream schedule/update_from_output bodies; upstream refactors silently diverge.

definitely_affected_paths: NPUPlatform directly subclasses Platform; any abstract-method/signature change (check_and_update_config, get_attn_backend_cls, get_compile_backend, get_device_communicator_cls, ...) breaks vllm-ascend at startup.
Platform registration/resolution logic determines whether NPUPlatform is selected; entry-point and name matching changes break platform boot.
AttentionBackend / AttentionMetadataBuilder / AttentionImplBase / MLAAttentionImpl are the base classes of every Ascend attention backend, builder and impl.
AttentionBackendEnum.get_path and register_backend are the mechanism Ascend uses to inject its attention classes.
WorkerBase is the base of NPUWorker/NPUWorker310/XliteWorker; constructor and deferred-sampling contracts are depended upon.
V2 GPUModelRunner is the base of the default NPUModelRunner (v2); execute_model/prepare_inputs/sample/initialize_kv_cache are overridden.
V1 GPUModelRunner is the base of NPUModelRunner (V1 fallback for LoRA/pooling/310P/spec).
InputBatch/InputBuffers are rebound module-globally to AscendInputBatch/AscendInputBuffers; field/layout changes break dummy runs and padded query_start_loc.
BlockTables.compute_slot_mappings contract and dtype (Ascend requires int32) are overridden by AscendBlockTables.
Ascend scheduler subclasses copy upstream schedule/update_from_output bodies; upstream refactors silently diverge.
Ascend KV cache specs subclass MLAAttentionSpec/SlidingWindowMLASpec/SlidingWindowSpec and rely on register_kv_cache_spec.
KV planning/prefix-cache behavior consumed by custom Ascend specs.
CompilerInterface is the base of AscendCompiler.
AbstractStaticGraphWrapper contract mirrored by ACLGraphWrapper (resolved via NPUPlatform.get_static_graph_wrapper_cls).
CUDAGraphMode/CUDAGraphOptions/BatchDescriptor and wrapper nesting contract are mirrored by ACLGraphWrapper/BreakableACLGraphWrapper.
VllmInductorPass base/context is used by Ascend fusion passes.
DeviceCommunicatorBase is the base of NPUCommunicator; collective API changes break TP/DP/EP and MoE communication.
GroupCoordinator is used directly; group construction and communicator negotiation affect Ascend device groups.
BaseModelLoader is the base of ModelNetLoaderElastic and RForkModelLoader; register_model_loader keys must stay stable.
MLAAttention/MLACommonMetadataBuilder are base/composition points for Ascend MLA support.
QuantizationConfig and specific configs are bases of the Ascend quant configs.
Protocol predicates (SupportsPP/LoRA/MoE/Eagle/HasInnerState) are implemented by Ascend-registered NPU models.
SpecDecodeBaseProposer/EagleProposer are bases of the Ascend V1 proposer family.
V2 speculator/CudaGraphManager contracts are bases of Ascend V2 spec decode (default MTP/Eagle/DSpark/DFlash path).
PunicaWrapperBase is the base of PunicaWrapperNPU.
ModelRegistry.register_model/get_supported_archs are used by Ascend's model plugin; the registry data itself is not modified.

CUDA/ROCm attention kernels are never selected on NPU (Ascend selects its own enum overrides/registered backends).
Legacy v0 attention backends are not used by the V1 NPU path.
GPU-only quantization methods are not implemented on Ascend.
vLLM CUDA C++ kernels are never built or executed on Ascend.
Ascend uses ACL graph managers; CUDA-specific capture utilities are not consumed.
Ascend never edits the upstream registry; it only adds entries through ModelRegistry.register_model, so internal table changes alone do not break Ascend.
